source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary: When this unit is under its **Starting Strength**, its models add 1 to their **Hit rolls**; when it is also **Below Half-strength**, they add 1 to their **Wound rolls** too.
